explainer.counted: Sudanese asylum seekers in Greece on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: People already recognised as refugees, and people who never applied.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

explainer.counted: The first year-end figure in UNHCR's series for this group (1993). The latest figure (2025) is also the highest on record.

explainer.counted: Sudanese asylum seekers in Greece as a share of all Sudanese asylum seekers in every host country on 31 December 2025 ({n0} of {n1}).
explainer.type: A share: one year-end stock divided by another, both from the same source.
explainer.not_included: People displaced inside the country of origin, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

UNHCR and IDMC both count people displaced inside the country, in different ways. They are shown side by side and never added.
